desc:
Rigshospitalet in Copenhagen, Denmark. Taken November 12, 2005, by Henrik Jessen.

The largest hospital in Denmark. The picture shows the main entrance and the 16 storeyed central building completed in the 1970'ies.

title: File:Rigshospitalet (388369907).jpg
desc:
riget. the late modern / brutalist hospital in central copenhagen made semi-famous with lars von trier's tv series "riget" - "the kingdom". it is quite a gloomy building and copenhagen winter mornings don't improve the impression. but the staff is great, they cured our daughter.
